question: usable solo follow-cam (self-operated, full run, real winds, minimal set-up) — round 4

usableInSimulation.leapfrog: conditionally yes, only inside a light-tailwind envelope: groomed low-traffic piste, calm/cross/head ≤9 m/s, true tailwind ≤≈5 m/s with the launch gate tightened to ≈5 m/s estimated, rider downhill speed ≤≈11 m/s, airframe ≤≈172 g, feathered wing CLmax ≥1.2, rider tag GNSS ≥5 Hz. Not for all-weather use (seeds 14–22 tail 5.5–6 m/s exceed 14.9 J / 50 m).
usableInSimulation.kite2: no — fails avail (72.3 %), and the passive 3 mm boom that makes the artefact rule pass is structurally infeasible (cannot cantilever/compress the KCU); a buildable 6→5 mm boom gives avail ≈6 %.
usableInSimulation.towglider: no — fails avail (48–49 %; launched runs 74 % mean so 80 % is unreachable); light-wind research concept only.

summary: leapfrog is the only concept passing all 13 judged metrics as modelled (5 conditional) and reproduces exactly, but its avail margin is 2.3 pp and its KE/C0-range margins fail on unseen seeds in the 5.5–6 m/s tail band. kite2 and towglider honestly fail avail. Ranking is by credible usable envelope × evidence × safety, not by count of passes. Evidence: numerical uncalibrated simulation; nothing physically tested.

order.label: only all-13 pass as modelled; thin, light-tailwind envelope
order.rationale: Exact reproduction; avail 82.46 (2.3 pp margin; lost at mass +8–10 % or CLmax 1.1), jitter 1.64 (2.01 with estimated tracker comp at 5 Hz GNSS, 3.43 fail at 1 Hz), setup p90 24.7 s (stow 13.5 s → 33 s fail), ops p90 2 (max 3), KE 13.75 J and headClear 2.01 m on grid; seeds 14–22 tail 5.5–6 → KE up to 16.05 J and 54.9 m range. Morphing wing goes beyond Ajanic 2020 (+100 % area by sliding feathers vs +41 % by sweep, CLmax 1.25 at Re≈34k, one 2.5 g servo). No tether/clothesline hazard. Needs a tighter tail gate (≈5 m/s est.) — not yet re-judged for avail.

order.label: fails avail; boom premise infeasible; clothesline unfixed
order.rationale: Reproduces (avail 72.25 vs 72.30, KE 14.275); winch now within a real 2205/25 A envelope (A3-K2-04 fixed). But the passive 3 mm, 1.45 m boom that meets the 2 px rule cannot nest 6 sections or carry/dock the 90 g KCU (≈930 MPa root stress, buckles at ≈1.3–2 N); a buildable 6→5 mm boom → avail ≈6 %. KE margin 0.62 J (L/D 0.6 → 17.26 J, mass +15 % → 16.95 J). Line 0.74–0.84 m above snow 1–3 m behind in every run. Strongest wind robustness of the flown concepts (non-tail 83 %), hence rank 2.

order.label: lowest burden, safe on grid by refusing, fails avail structurally
order.rationale: Exact reproduction; ops 1, setup 12 s, 0.46 kg, KE 13.2 J. avail 48.0 (17/48 refused; launched 74 % mean so ≥80 % unreachable; pre-run history → 53 %). Tail-band hazard of round 3 fixed by refusing ≥3.5 m/s. crossL7.5_s11 headClear 0.934 m off-grid. Jitter pass needs ≥6 Hz loaded servo (4 Hz → 4.4 °/s fail); endurance needs a 0.05 W lift sleep (0.5 W → 40 min fail).

order.label: frozen negative result (round-2 row unchanged)
order.rationale: Round-2 audit: fails avail 29.6 %, setup 60 s, ops p90 3, KE 18 J, jitter p90 18 °/s. Not re-run.

nextKillTests: leapfrog: bench/tow the sliding-feather wing for CLmax and area extension at Re 30–40k (kill CLmax <1.1 or mass >175 g); rider-tag GNSS rate/latency on a carving skier (kill <5 Hz or >100 ms); tail 5–6 m/s launch-gate test with a real wind estimate; gloved −10 °C stow ≤10 s

kite2: build a 1.45 m boom that cantilevers/docks a 90 g KCU and measure its projected width in real 4K footage (kill if >2 px median); tow-test canopy L/D (kill <0.7); clothesline mitigation + resort permission
towglider: loaded camera-servo bandwidth at −10 °C (kill <6 Hz); sleep current of the whole avionics stack (kill >0.3 W); crosswind 7–8 m/s stall-drop clearance
all: resort written permission; G-MATURE closed; M-070 not_run
